title: Unchecked Return Value in FastAccessVault Transfer (FLAGGED - may be known issue #7)
description: The processTransfer() function does not check the return value of the transfer operation, which could lead to silent failures and loss of funds. This may correspond to known issue #7 in the project documentation.
impact: Failed transfers may not be detected, leading to inconsistent state where the vault believes funds were transferred but the actual transfer failed, potentially resulting in loss of funds.
